# The environment contract every SDK's connect path reads, pinned as data —
# the half a fixture cannot express, in the shape
# `test/fixtures/host_class_decl_keys.txt` uses for declaration keys.
#
# Three readers pin it: a `flz_transport` test asserts the ladder's own
# constants and rung order are exactly these; the static gate asserts no SDK's
# connect path reads a socket or address variable this file does not list, and
# that the rungs appear here in the order the ladder walks them; and both
# assert no SDK and no test app honours a retired name.
#
# Adding a variable: teach `flz_transport`, add it here, and account for it in
# every SDK — one change, every SDK (docs/public/architecture/runner.md).
#
# Columns are whitespace-separated: `kind`, then the value(s) for that kind.

# Variables the connect path reads.
variable  FLEZHA_SOCKET_FILES_PATH
variable  FLEZHA_QUIC_ADDRESSES
variable  FLEZHA_SOCKET_DIR_GROUP
variable  XDG_RUNTIME_DIR

# Names that are no longer honoured. An SDK or test app reading one of these is
# a gate failure: a silent ignore looks exactly like the bug the replacement
# exists to remove. The one file allowed to name a retired variable is the one
# that refuses it, `flz_transport/src/transport/config.rs`.
retired   FLEZHA_QUIC_ADDRESS

# The socket-directory ladder, in the order it is walked. The first rung, when
# set, is used outright — no later rung is tried.
ladder    1  explicit      $FLEZHA_SOCKET_FILES_PATH
ladder    2  xdg_runtime   $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/flezha
ladder    3  run           /run/flezha
ladder    4  repository    app_data/sockets
